runs.description: 30-minute engine stability run started before patched toolchain update
Patched release build repeated native FUSE, crash-recovery, full race/provider tests and 120-second pressure workload

qualification: Source hashes and binary hashes are embedded in each report. The sustained run and patched release use the same execution/cache/lazy implementation. A subsequent Git-only pack clone/copy change was covered by rerun Git and provider regressions; this directory-base soak does not exercise Git pack materialization. The release smoke overlapped the tail of the long run; these are shared-host workload measurements, not isolated backend microbenchmarks. Pinned trim requests intentionally returning 429 count as pressure, not workload failures. No long-run production SLO is asserted.
